fixture.note: Explicit density fixture adds normal enemies through spawnEnemy and preserves initial enemies, spawnClock, HP, speed, AI, damage and normal subsequent spawning. Existing Continue/preload/resume UI launches the memory-only checkpoint.

armPreparation.note: Browser QA owns a fresh original ProductionArt per arm and restores the prior loader. The prior loader remains alive during comparison, so these are not product peak-memory measurements. Only the actual synchronous parseMetadata call is timed; fetch/PNG decode/preload/render preparation are separate. performance.memory samples may be unavailable, rounded or process-wide, include garbage and other owners, and are not continuous peak/live heap, total RAM or VRAM. No forced browser GC or texture/clip/frame/source reduction is used. Combat uses the normal pooled physics grid and renderer preparation in every arm.

preparation.note: Original native texture submission and shader API readiness before launch; not GPU completion, measured FPS or first-draw validation. A maximum of three original enemy models is owned until adoption.

costs.note: QA measures synchronous CPU call wall time, including waits and observer overhead. Nested stage observations overlap and must not be summed. This is not GPU execution time, presented FPS, paint or total memory. First-observed owner identities are not game/model construction times. Scoped production.drawFrame stages observe only original calls on the existing ProductionArt instance within the innermost enemy/boss/corpse/player/obstacle/decor renderer category; extra hit-light draws remain separate calls. Category and source subtotals overlap their parent stages, and calls are not unique actors. Native classification uses the existing liveRig metadata flag or original live-player ID; baked requires the original atlas format and a string asset ID; unrecognized selections remain unknown. No Canvas method hooks are added for sprite timing. The observer performs no tick, render, pose, draw, pixel read, upload, event drain or scheduling calls.

native.note: Counts actual original native renderer.render calls only; no native/Canvas timing wrappers or extra draws/reads are installed.

note: Owned metadata JSON experiment: beforeArm owns the independent original asset loader per arm. All three physics grids and renderer preparation use production defaults. 8851 genuine-memory QA only. Default grid experiment: original inline fresh separation Map/buckets with source counters → pooled → original fresh; forceAllFresh is a separate all-original control. observeCosts=false removes detailed/Canvas timing observers and retains only an actual native renderer.render call counter. allSummary includes all40 frames, including warmup outliers. Same normal60/180 checkpoint, AI/HP/automatic fire/spawning/offered upgrades, fixed .12s catch-up through actual advanceSimulation and pooled interpolation, 40renders/batch8/10warm excluded. Every arm owns a new original256 NPC rig with the same bounded three-model texture/shader preparation, excluded from combat timing, and primes the actual renderer without ticks before measurement. Main player/world caches can still vary. Allocation counters count the helper source objects, not heap/GC/RAM/VRAM bytes or all JavaScript allocations. No presented FPS, GPU execution or full product HUD/audio/save claim. Stage wrappers add overhead and nested call-wall times overlap. Original rig/resolution/materials/clips/positions/private outputs remain in use.
